verdict.rationale: Goodwin documents a dedicated Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice that it calls top-ranked and long-standing, with specialists across the United States and Europe. That establishes a documented privacy/cyber practice, but the evidence never says the practice counsels on compliance or names GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or equivalent regimes. missing for 10: explicit compliance-counseling scope, named regimes (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP), detail on services offered, independent corroboration such as rankings or matters.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Our top-ranked Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice is one of the longest-standing of any Am Law 50 firm. Across the United States and Europe, our specialists include former federal prosecutors.
